verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26199033 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318687 (dated 2026-06-29). One line: 18,500 pcs of PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6 at 25.62 CNY each, confirmed for 2026-09-10. Terms are FOB Yantian, NET30. A note says the lid magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 per box) are fitted in the supplier's plant and included in the unit price.
observations: Single-page, printed document with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date of its own. The only date besides the confirmed delivery date is the customer order date, 2026-06-29.
The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
